negative_findings.description: None of the four state banks appears to run a Western-style 'Investor Relations' section with an IR calendar, results presentations and analyst contacts. Disclosure is split between statutory issuer pages (звітність емітента / регулярна інформація) and the MoF shareholder pages.

negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must target statutory disclosure pages plus MoF, not an IR RSS/calendar; expect annual PDF drops rather than quarterly investor decks.

brief: Ukraine's four state-owned banks publish IR-grade material, but through statutory disclosure pages rather than any true investor-relations function: PrivatBank via its financial-statements page plus a genuinely IR-quality English Integrated Report series, Oschadbank via 'звітність емітента цінних паперів' and an English news feed, and Ukrgasbank via the most complete and best-structured IFRS tree of the four (annual audited, interim, and regular issuer information). The Ministry of Finance acts as a shareholder-side aggregator hosting copies of all four banks' reports plus monthly performance decks, and SMIDA is the machine-readable statutory backstop keyed by EDRPOU. Weak points are Sense Bank, whose disclosure tree could not be mapped from search alone, and eurobond/LPN-specific investor documentation, which does not appear to live on issuer sites. Access is complicated by bot defences (mof.gov.ua 403, oschadbank.ua redirect loop) and by heavy English-language name collision with unrelated 'Privatbank' entities in Luxembourg, Latvia and Austria.
